title: Tall Utah celery: Characteristics
metaDescription: Tall Utah celery is an open pollinated celery variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Tall Utah celery is an open pollinated celery variety. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources.

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Tall Utah celery is grown

blocks.text: The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [celery variety finder](/crop-varieties/celery), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).
Key facts about Tall Utah celery

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit celery fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Fruit:** Stalks: long, dark green, thick and firm, on an upright, compact plant.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: allied Botanical sells it in 50 g cans for growers, no independent evidence found. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual celery on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Tall Utah celery

Kintsay grows best in cool weather, so most of it comes from the highlands. Pick a variety by stalk or leaf: the big stalk celery for the market, or the small leafy Chinese kind for soups. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.a: Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Tall Utah?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
